title: Bill Cipher Totem
description: A retexture of the minecraft totem if undying
body:
**Main Feature – Bill Cipher Totem of Undying**

Replaces the Totem of Undying with Bill Cipher, the all-powerful dream demon from Gravity Falls. Now, every time you avoid death, it's thanks to Bill’s chaotic power (you might want to keep an eye on him).

**Bonus Feature – Journal 3**

All books and enchanted books are retextured to look like Journal 3, complete with the iconic six-fingered hand symbol. Perfect for lore builds or fans of the mystery!

**_Add a little weirdness to your world. Just remember… reality is an illusion, the universe is a hologram, buy gold, BYE!_**

Dont forget to subscribe to my [Youtube Channel](https://www.youtube.com/@phoenixman1000) and join my [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/2ZSVcuT3a5)
